Maria C.: _Quick design review_ — attaching a mini-timeline mock for rollouts. Main asks: does compact mode still communicate canary allocation clearly? and is rollback affordance discoverable? https://figma.com/file/xyz (screenshots in thread) Leah - Design: I tightened vertical rhythm to fit more versions. Concern: the percent pill gets visually lost at 2–3 variants. Maybe color + icon treatment, and a text label for screen readers. Josh (ENG): Agree on the tiny pills being hard to scan. From infra side, we can easily expose a tooltip with exact numbers and a copy for the aria label. But avoid fetching extra data on hover for perf. Samir (frontend): Proposed HTML structure: ```
5% Variant A — 5% traffic
``` We can use CSS focus-visible to show outline for keyboard. Olivia (a11y): Please ensure the pill's colour contrast passes AA when used as a status indicator. Also suggest adding `aria-live` region to announce rollout start/rollback events for assistive tech. Example copy for announcement: \"Canary started: Variant A at 5 percent.\" Maria C.: Good. UX copy tweak: current CTA says \"Rollback\" which some PMs fear is destructive. Can we change to \"Revert to previous\" or show confirmation modal with clear non-technical language? Leah - Design: I prefer \"Revert to previous version\" (longer but clearer). Also thinking of adding a small chevron to expand variant details inline instead of navigating away. Inline diff preview would help SREs. Josh (ENG): Inline diff preview is doable but needs a debounce for heavy diffs. Also, we should limit preview to < 1 MB payload or show a link to full diff. Samir (frontend): UX nit — hovercards currently block the small timeline scrubber. If we move hovercards to side and make them dismiss on ESC, scrubber remains keyboard reachable. Olivia (a11y): Keyboard order proposal: timeline scrubber -> variant list (tab into each pill) -> expand details. Ensure ESC closes expanded details and returns focus to the pill that opened it. Also announce \"details opened\" via `aria-live` polite. Leah - Design: Copy suggestions for pill tooltip: Line 1 = Variant name, Line 2 = \"Traffic: 5% (approx.)\" Line 3 = timestamp of rollout start. For rollbacks: modal header = \"Revert deployment\"; body = \"This will switch live traffic back to version v42. No data is deleted.\" Confirm CTA: \"Revert to v42\" Cancel CTA: \"Keep current\". Maria C.: Love the explicit \"No data is deleted\" line — removes panic. Also let's A/B test wording: group A sees \"Rollback\" group B sees \"Revert to previous version\" and measure clicks to confirm/abort. Keep it behind an experiment flag. Josh (ENG): Quick design-implementation sync: we will add `data-experiment=\"revert-copy\"` to the modal component so product can flip labels without deploy. Samir (frontend): Small CSS ask: alternate row highlighting on compact timeline helps scanning. Use `prefers-reduced-motion` for any animation on expand. Olivia (a11y): Also ensure we do not rely on color alone for variant state — add (Live) / (Canary) textual markers and visible focus outlines. deploy-bot: Canary deployed — Variant A at 5% — triggered by maria.c — ts:1860001270 Maria C.: Thanks all. Action items: Leah to iterate mock with expanded copy and contrast tweaks; Samir to prototype keyboard flow; Olivia to produce acceptance checklist for a11y; Josh to wire experiment flag. I'll schedule a 30m sync early next week to review the prototype. :calendar: Leah - Design: Uploaded v2 mock with updated pills + modal copy (link in thread). I'll mark the accessibility checkbox inline. Samir (frontend): I'll start with the tabbable list component and post a demo GIF. Olivia (a11y): I'll draft announcement text variants for the `aria-live` region and run quick SR tests. Josh (ENG): Putting the experiment flag PR in this afternoon. Maria C.: Great — closing thread for now. If anyone spots edge cases (multi-region failover, snapshot replays), ping here. :raised_hands:
